thread.title: CIRP: iPhone XR took 32% share in November - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: CIRP: iPhone XR took 32% share in November - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple's (NASDAQ: AAPL ) iPhone XR took a 32% share of iPhones in November, according to CIRP data. The share was better than the 30% for the iPhone X in last year's period but lower than the iPhone 8/8 Plus at 39%.
CIRP says that 16% of iPhone buyers in the month switched over from Android, up from the 12% switch in 2017.
The CIRP study included 165 US customers who purchased an XR in the 30 days after launch.
Apple shares are up 1.9% to $149.65.
